videos.title: A Quiet Clock Hidden in a Length #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: A painted bob is already moving at the start, with a stable light cue.
editorial.mechanism: Two comparisons preserve the small-angle square-root period ratios and the same effective gravity; labels distinguish length and cycles.
editorial.readability: The length labels were separated from the period formula after preview overlap. The smallest final bob is still quite small.
editorial.pacing: Motion continues during most narration, with an explicit stopped release for the first pair. The final pair keeps oscillating.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; differences were number formatting, a split compound word and one omitted conjunction with unchanged mathematical meaning. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The period law is explained and demonstrated rather than derived from torque. Small bobs limit the perceived material detail; this remains a clean diagram, with no measured viewer response.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: The Different Lives Inside Two Circles #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: Two circular objects begin rolling on equal offset ramps; the objects were enlarged after the first preview.
editorial.mechanism: The cylinder uses a flat face and restrained rim rather than spherical shading. Clockwise markers track distance divided by radius; moving the final release backward preserves the finish location.
editorial.readability: The hoop label was moved away from the upper ramp. Separate ramp levels require viewers to compare descent rather than absolute height.
editorial.pacing: The second release and greater descent visibly compare acceleration. Motion freezes at each comparison endpoint; these stops are not simulated collisions.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; differences were number formatting, a split compound word and one omitted conjunction with unchanged mathematical meaning. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: There is no energy partition diagram, and the material treatment is deliberately reduced to avoid misidentifying a cylinder as a sphere. The endpoint freeze is editorial, not physical braking.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: The Empty Space That Grows with a Ring #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: A ring expands immediately, with both boundaries scaling together.
editorial.mechanism: An imaginary matching disk expands with the surrounding material; an unchanged cooler ball later reveals increased clearance.
editorial.readability: Large shapes remain distinct. The visual exaggeration and uniform free expansion are stated; formula notation still assumes familiarity with symbols.
editorial.pacing: Two short expansions and the final ball comparison resolve the relationship. Much of the explanatory middle holds a static ring.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; differences were number formatting, a split compound word and one omitted conjunction with unchanged mathematical meaning. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: No actual temperature field or heat flow is simulated. The 18-percent visual enlargement is not a quantitative prediction from the small-change formula. The ring itself remains a stylized face.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: The Square Hidden in a Returning Ball #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: An enlarged painted ball drops and rebounds above one floor.
editorial.mechanism: The rebound trajectory uses constant gravitational acceleration and selected restitution. Height markers were corrected to track the ball bottom consistently above the floor.
editorial.readability: Quarter and nine-sixteenth levels are distinct; the bottom of the ball reaches the relevant level at its apex.
editorial.pacing: Each comparison shows one rebound, followed by a held endpoint. The model does not continue secondary bounces.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; differences were number formatting, a split compound word and one omitted conjunction with unchanged mathematical meaning. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: Dry narration offers no impact sound; subjective listening was unavailable. The brief rebound is followed by lengthy explanation, and there is no diagram of energy changing form.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: The Quiet Difference Made by a Connection #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: Two spring arrangements respond differently to the same controlled pull.
editorial.mechanism: Series extensions add while parallel springs share the force. The unchanged unloaded endpoint gives the extension markers a common reference; doubling the pull preserves four to one.
editorial.readability: The springs, pulls, extension markers and formulas remain separate. The tangible handles are small compared with the arrangement.
editorial.pacing: Transitions interpolate settled configurations, explicitly identified as such. The final doubled load is held for comparison.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed; differences were number formatting, a split compound word and one omitted conjunction with unchanged mathematical meaning. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: This is a static compliance explanation rather than a dynamic spring simulation. There is no tangible actuator or textured environment; material character is modest.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.
